_readme: What the on-device model can and can't do. Read by src/lib/capability.ts. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions; keywords match whole words or phrases. Order matters: the first unsupported category that matches wins. Templates use {request}, {sources} and {grounding}.
grounding: The attached {what} {is} the source of truth. Answer only from {it}, and say clearly when something isn't in {it}.
groundingClipboard: The {what} {is} pasted below and {is} the source of truth. Answer only from {it}, and say clearly when something isn't in {it}.
noSources: I haven't attached any meeting material, so ask me for what you need instead of guessing.

defaultTemplate.label: Ask about a meeting
defaultTemplate.simulatedReply: I've read the transcript of {source}. Tell me what you'd like to do with it, for example a summary for someone who missed the meeting, open questions, or a follow-up message.

supported.label: Keyword search across meetings, memos and transcripts
examples: kestrel
CSV import
pricing

supported.label: Open a transcript at a timestamp
examples: open the Kestrel transcript at 01:20

supported.label: Show a meeting's existing summary
examples: summary of the Kestrel call
what happened in the design review

supported.label: List action items already in a summary
examples: action items from the Kestrel call
next steps

supported.label: Answer simple lookup questions
examples: when is the Kestrel signing deadline?
who is responsible for the CSV import?
how much does Kestrel cost?
patterns: ^(when|who|where|how much|how many|how long|what time|what date|which day)\b

unsupported.label: Drafting text
unsupported.cantLocal: Nexo can't write emails, messages or follow-ups on your device.
examples: write a follow-up email to Kestrel
draft a message to the team about the launch date
compose a reply to Brightside
unsupported.simulatedReply: Here is where a first draft would appear, based on {source}. In a real session, Claude writes it from the transcript and you can ask for changes before you send anything.

unsupported.label: Comparing or analysing across meetings
unsupported.cantLocal: Nexo can't compare or analyse several meetings or memos on your device.
examples: compare the two customer interviews
summarize across all Nexo meetings
analyze how the launch plan changed
unsupported.simulatedReply: Here is where a comparison of {source} would appear, organised by topic. In a real session, Claude works only from the attached transcripts and says what isn't in them.

unsupported.label: Open-ended reasoning
unsupported.cantLocal: Nexo can find what was said, but it can't reason about it on your device.
examples: what were the risks of the launch?
what should we do about the CSV import?
why might the beta fail?
unsupported.simulatedReply: Here is where a reasoned answer would appear, based on {source}. In a real session, Claude separates what the transcript says from its own reasoning.

unsupported.label: Translating
unsupported.cantLocal: Nexo can't translate on your device.
examples: translate the Kestrel summary into German
the design review in Swedish
unsupported.simulatedReply: Here is where the translation of {source} would appear. In a real session, Claude keeps names, numbers and dates exactly as in the transcript.

unsupported.label: Rewriting or reformatting
unsupported.cantLocal: Nexo can't rewrite or reformat summaries on your device.
examples: rewrite the Kestrel summary as bullet points
make the design review summary shorter
turn the retro into a table
unsupported.simulatedReply: Here is where the rewritten version of {source} would appear. In a real session, Claude only uses what is in the transcript.

unsupported.label: Knowledge outside your data
unsupported.cantLocal: Nexo only knows your own recordings, and this needs knowledge from outside them.
examples: what is the weather today?
what are typical SaaS onboarding benchmarks?
latest news about invoicing rules
unsupported.simulatedReply: Here is where an answer would appear. In a real session, Claude says clearly which parts come from {source} and which from general knowledge.
